extraction.Name: Susan Charbonneau
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 15, 1918, by R. E. Wang
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Whittemore & Lewis Investment Company for $1100 on March 12, 1918; mortgage satisfied October 14, 1918; sold by deed to William Lamoureaux for $5000 on December 6, 1918
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612673 issued; Northeast quarter section 18, township 36, north of range 26; receipt for patent was signed by the allottee but not dated
